meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动移除项目中未使用的代码，保证安全并生成原子提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目积累了大量死代码需要安全清理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically remove unused code with safety and atomic commits
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project has accumulated dead code that needs safe removal

howto.what: 当你要求清理未使用的代码时,它会扫描项目找出疑似死代码,用代码分析工具确认无人引用后,派多个并行子代理分批删除,每批单独提交;且会跳过入口文件、测试、配置等。
howto.when: 当你说出“remove dead code”“dead code”“cleanup”等清理未使用代码的请求时触发。

say.text: 请清理这个项目里的未使用代码。
say.note: 启动全项目扫描,删除确认的死代码。

say.text: 只清理 src/features 目录下的死代码。
say.note: 扫描范围限定在该目录。

say.text: 清理 src/utils.ts 里的未使用代码。

howto.what_en: When asked to remove unused code, it scans for suspected dead code, confirms with LSP that nothing references it, then dispatches parallel agents to delete in batches and commit each. It skips entry points, tests, configs, and packages/.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'remove dead code', 'dead code', 'cleanup', or similar requests to clean up unused code.

say_en.text: Please remove unused code from this project.
say_en.note: Runs a full-project scan and deletes confirmed dead code.

say_en.text: Clean up dead code in src/features only.
say_en.note: Limits the scan to that directory.
